about: Every NALTP match the archive holds: season -> league -> week -> that week's games. A game's score is in the order its two teams are named. record says where the match itself is: tagpro.eu, a pastebin the archive saved when tagpro.eu has none, or null where no record was found, in which case why says what is known and hub_score gives the season hub's score. Line-ups and tags are the home team's side first.
